faqs.q: Can you repair my microwave the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Same-day microwave repair is our standard service in Houston and nearby cities. Call or book online and we will schedule a technician to come out the same day.

faqs.q: Is the microwave repair estimate free?
faqs.a: Yes. The technician diagnoses the microwave and gives you a free estimate before any work starts, so you can decide with the price in front of you.

faqs.q: What warranty do microwave repairs have?
faqs.a: Every microwave repair is covered by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

faqs.q: Do you repair built-in and drawer microwaves?
faqs.a: Yes. Built-in, drawer and over-the-range microwaves — including wall oven and microwave combination units from brands like GE, KitchenAid, Thermador and Jenn-Air — are the models most worth repairing, and we service them in place without damaging the cabinetry.

faqs.q: Is a basic countertop microwave worth repairing?
faqs.a: Often it is not: a simple countertop unit can cost less to replace than to repair. We tell you that honestly at the estimate. Built-in, drawer and over-the-range models are a different story — replacing them involves cabinetry or venting, so a repair usually makes sense.

faqs.q: Why does my microwave run but not heat the food?
faqs.a: The usual causes are a failed magnetron, a bad high-voltage diode or capacitor, or a faulty door switch. These are standard repairs, but the high-voltage circuit holds a dangerous charge even when the microwave is unplugged, so this is not a do-it-yourself job.

faqs.q: My microwave sparks inside. Can I keep using it?
faqs.a: No — stop using it. Sparking usually comes from a worn waveguide cover, damaged rack supports or burned spots in the cavity. Running it that way can damage the magnetron and scorch the interior. It is repairable; book a visit before using it again.
